description: This file contains Flutter widget classes for displaying recipe information, including a recipe card and a list tile, both with visual elements and interactions. It also includes an internal widget for image display with loading/error handling.

classes.name: RecipeCard
classes.description: A reusable, tappable widget displaying recipe image, title, duration, and servings in a card layout.

classes.name: RecipeListTile
classes.description: A compact list tile widget showing recipe image, title, duration, servings, and navigation icon.

classes.name: _RecipeImage
classes.description: Internal widget for displaying a recipe image with loading and error handling, supporting network and asset images.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each of the widget classes based on context.
